0.11.2 is a patch of 0.11 and interoperates with 0.11.0 and 0.11.1: format epoch 7, backup format 5, protocol line `11` and every storage, wire and protocol format are unchanged, and the server, the gateway and `ursulactl` change only their version. 0.11.0, 0.11.1 and 0.11.2 nodes run in one cluster, and extensions of all three work with any of these servers and open, read and import the same streams. The extension's local formats are unchanged, its SQL functions keep their arguments, and its new functions, error kinds and fields are additions. Upgrade a cluster in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`), with no fresh install or data move. Upgrade the SQLite client by installing `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` 0.11.2 or replacing the extension library. Rolling back to 0.11.1 or 0.11.0 is safe.

- **The extension says what each failure is.** `ursula_classify(message, errcode, path)` takes SQLite's message and result code for a failure and returns its `kind`, `action`, `class`, the `message` a host shows, `fix` and `request_id`, or `null` for SQLite's own errors. Events, `ursula_cancel`, `status().refused` and `status().reset` carry `class` too. `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` now classifies through it and throws the same errors as before.
- **A forked child fails `forked`.** In a child forked after the extension started, every SQL function fails `forked` (action `fix`: open after the fork) and every I/O on a file of a bound database fails, so the child never stalls on `synced()`, appends to the parent's log or writes the parent's connections. A child forked before the start is unaffected.
- **API keys in the extension.** The extension exchanges a Tonbo API key for Streams tokens and refreshes them on a thread of its own, so a busy host never delays a refresh. A token the host sets and `URSULA_VFS_TOKEN_FILE` come first. `ursula_status` reports the token source.
- **`tonbo_resolve`.** A new SQL function resolves a Tonbo database by name to its stream URL inside the extension, with the key from the `api_key` option, `TONBO_API_KEY` or the `tonbo login` file, so every host shares one implementation.
- **`@tonbo/sqlite-ursula/tonbo` resolves through the extension.** `/tonbo` and `/tonbo/pi` call `tonbo_resolve` and carry no Tonbo logic of their own. `resolveDatabase` now returns `token: undefined` when the key's tokens serve, where 0.11.1 returned a provider, so pass `token` through as it is. A key the token endpoint refuses fails `resolveDatabase` itself, a second key fails `invalid_argument` while the first may serve, and `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` no longer applies to the lookup.
- **The `sqlite-ursula` Python package.** `clients/sqlite-ursula-python` is the Python peer of `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula` for the stdlib `sqlite3` module of CPython 3.11 or newer. It is in the tree but not yet published on PyPI.
- **`ursula-vfs-host drain`.** For hosts that snapshot or move a process or the VM it runs in: `drain` reopens the roots on the host's disk that no process holds and that still hold commits the stream has not acknowledged, and sends those commits. It continues each root's own claim, never takes a stream over, and drains only the roots its effective user owns, so a host runs it as the user of the workload.
- **`ursula-vfs-host prune`.** `prune` removes the records of cache directories that no longer exist, and only after a complete inspection pass. `--tmp` also removes temp files whose writer is gone.

Known issues: the known issues of 0.11.0 are unchanged. Every change is listed in the [0.11.2 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#0112).
